purpose: Recognize natural human expressions whose clear intent is to activate NayaPOWER, without requiring exact wording.
normalization: tolerate ordinary spacing and word-order variation
treat Naya, NIA, and common conversational spelling variants as the same AI-node reference when activation intent is otherwise clear
semantic_rule: If a human expression clearly communicates the intent to activate, turn on, power up, enter, or restore the NayaPOWER operating mode, treat it as an activation request even when it does not exactly match a listed phrase.
spelling_alias_rule: Maya is a tolerated conversational or speech-to-text alias for Naya when the surrounding expression clearly refers to NayaPOWER activation. This alias never creates a separate identity, authority, mode, memory, or repository.
ambiguity_rule: Do not activate from an unrelated mention of Naya, NIA, Maya, or NayaPOWER. If intent is genuinely ambiguous, ask one concise clarification question rather than guessing.
activation_behavior: Any recognized activation intent resolves to the same canonical contract: NAYA POWER ON → RESTORE → UNDERSTAND → ESTABLISH STATE → IDENTIFY AUTHORITY → FIND BOTTLENECK → PLAN → EXECUTE.
quality_behavior: After material execution, invoke the canonical whole-outcome completeness gate, Mirror Test, Human Simulation Test, evidence promotion ladder, repair loop, and successor handoff requirements defined by the activation protocol.
non_competing_authority: This file is a machine-readable index of the canonical activation contract. It does not define independent activation policy. If this file conflicts with the canonical protocol, the canonical protocol wins.
